lemoncorp.description: The zesty consumer-tech conglomerate behind half the gadgets in Europe. Famously overvalued, famously beloved.

petrodyne.description: Oil, gas and everything that burns. Pumps crude from the Petrocave and pays steady, sooty dividends.

soulforge.description: Refines and trades soul-crystals. Volatile, ethically dubious, spectacularly profitable when the veil is thin.

hypernetsystems.description: The backbone of the Hypernet itself. Owns the pipes, the towers and most of your data.

ferrosteelworks.description: Girders, rails and hull plating. Boring, heavy, and quietly essential to everyone who builds anything.

greenwitchorganics.description: Herbs, tinctures and suspiciously effective produce grown under the GreenWitch canopy.

vaultbankholdings.description: Deposits, loans and the vaults that hold them. If you owe money, you probably owe it here.

aetherlogistics.description: Trains, buses, helicopters and the timetables that bind them. Moves people and cargo across the map.
